content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate in Agriculture. Experience: Desirable: at least two years of experience in start-up-related activities. Other conditions: No TA/DA shall be payable for attending the interview Desirable: Sound knowledge of basic computer applications and the internet. Good oral and written communication skills in English and Hindi. At least two years of experience in start-up-related activities.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure extendable subject to satisfactory performance and the guidelines/approval of the Department of Industries, Government of Bihar. Engagement and continuation subject to Department of Industries guidelines and approval and University administrative orders. Engagement does not by itself confer any right to regular appointment or absorption in the University or the Department of Industries.
